(bullets drawn at motor end). Swap 2 phases to reverse.

prop rotation as seen from the nose (prop side)
Gauges: 12 AWG pack/pigtail, 14 AWG PDB→ESC, 18 AWG motor,
26 AWG servo, 28 AWG JST-GH/SH; 22 AWG balance lead.
Motor order = ArduPilot quad-X tailsitter; ESC ch n = FC Sn.
Diagonal pairs counter-rotate (M1/M2 CCW, M3/M4 CW).
1. Ports per parts/avionics.json: Rx CRSF on SERIAL6 (ELRS header),
USB extender on SERIAL1, GPS on the GH6 GPS port (UART + I²C),
2. Compass on a mast, 84.6 mm from the 12 AWG pigtail:
twist +/− pairs and motor triplets; calibrate with motors on.
3. ESC SH8 cable FC end is cut; S1–S4 + GND soldered to PWM pads.
